WITH race_name_totals AS (
  SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS average_laps
  FROM results AS res
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
), cutoff AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_points) AS average_total_points
  FROM race_name_totals
), kept AS (
  SELECT t.total_points, t.average_laps, c.average_total_points
  FROM race_name_totals AS t
  CROSS JOIN cutoff AS c
  WHERE t.total_points > c.average_total_points
)
SELECT SUM(total_points) AS sum_total_points,
       AVG(average_laps) AS average_of_race_name_average_laps,
       AVG(total_points - average_total_points) AS average_excess_points
FROM kept
